NARROW-PRE-QUEUE-RESUME.how: Own empty stand-in; the game's RunQueue (733) stops its own timer when it sees it — the collection calls no timer API. Restore puts the saved table back only when our stand-in is still present, then calls the existing StartQueue (175-180) which itself refuses to start a second timer when SpawnQueueTimer ~= 0. Old timer ids are never stored or revived.
NARROW-PRE-QUEUE-RESUME.checks: lifecycle §4 (12 queued jobs held, timer self-stops, restore → exactly one new timer, all 12 drain), §5 (same-tick restore → StartQueue sees the live timer, no new timer), §10 (StartQueue error caught, finish reaches its end line).

NARROW-PRE-CLEAR-SIDE-EFFECT.how: ClearMode=false for the held generation skips the whole Poll clear block (365-402) during the collection: no clear-empty WakeAll, no Cleared/gold/banner/MapCleared. Nothing is granted or undone; restored at finish (same generation, still false).
NARROW-PRE-CLEAR-SIDE-EFFECT.checks: lifecycle §3 (held: alive=0 → 0 WakeAll/spawn/reward/MapCleared · control A without hold → WakeAll spawns 6 · control B tables emptied but ClearMode on → reward) · full-dryrun SCENE lines = 0/0/0/0 for all 3 templates × 2 variants · original-template control allclear → rewards=1 wakeAll=1 spawned=3 during collection.
NARROW-PRE-CLEAR-SIDE-EFFECT.why_not_count_preservation: Keeping PendingCount() equal would not stop Poll: with alive=0 the game still runs clear-empty WakeAll (spawns into the arena, control A), and with pending ≤ spawnBatch the same Poll grants the floor clear (observation below). A count-preserving stand-in would also need the running queue timer stopped (timer API).

NARROW-PRE-REFERENCE-OWNERSHIP.how: Original references saved, never mutated; own stand-ins identified by identity; each table restored independently and only if our (still empty) stand-in is installed; exact entity/map (incl. root Entity==map) and SpawnedAt generation required; capture only when SpawnedAt > 0.
NARROW-PRE-REFERENCE-OWNERSHIP.checks: lifecycle §1 (exact references back, originals untouched, child spawner), §6 (Sleep / SpawnAll / foreign table / written stand-in / ClearMode re-set by others → not overwritten), §7 (nil PendingPacks round-trips as nil; SpawnedAt 0 → not held, unspawned=1 logged), §8 (root spawner with CurrentMap nil), §9b (Lv5 cellar1, Lv30 smuggler1, Lv15 non-kingtomb1 → InflowOn-only).
NARROW-PRE-REFERENCE-OWNERSHIP.table_identity_assumption: Assumes `property any` returns the same Lua table to the maker script. Evidence: canonical owns() already relies on `_Telemetry.DpsCollection == collection` (Telemetry.mlua 42, property any) and run4 passed owns() (begin/targets lines). If identity ever failed, restore would skip and log wake_skipped (pending packs then stay empty until that map's next generation) — visible, not silent.

NARROW-PRE-FINISH.how: No new exit path: everything restores inside the existing restoreArenaInflow, which finish calls first; finish is idempotent (finished flag + inflowStates swapped to {}); S90 (DpsCollectionStop→collection.stop), replaced, death, leave, timeout, setup error all converge on it.
